stories.headline: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's testimony to Senate banking committee hits on economy, interest rates
stories.body: As part of congressionally mandated Capitol Hill appearances for the central bank leader, Warsh spoke Tuesday to the House financial services committee.

stories.headline: How wide is the gender pay gap among financial advisors?
stories.body: An albeit smaller sample of financial advisors participating in FP's Compensation Survey nevertheless reflected the industry-wide trend around gender pay gaps.
